description: This file defines a theme configuration for a Flutter application, encapsulated within the ThemeConfig class. It specifies color palettes and theme data for use throughout the app, including styles for AppBar, Card, InputDecoration, Button, and TextTheme.

classes.name: ThemeConfig
classes.description: A utility class providing static theming configurations using Material 3 for the Flutter app.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: A static getter that returns the application's ThemeData, configured with custom colors and styles based on the Ocean Professional color palette.
